products.title: My First ABC Book
products.coverAlt: My First ABC Book cover — colorful ABC letters with an apple, a beach ball and a kitten
products.description: Meet the alphabet one letter at a time. Each page pairs a big letter with a picture word — A is for Apple, B is for Ball, C is for Cat — with a color guide and tracing practice, so little ones learn, color and write their first letters.
features: 26 letters from A to Z, each with a picture word
Color guide and letter-tracing practice on every page
Phonics hints such as “A is for Apple”
products.seoTitle: My First ABC Book | Printable ABC Coloring Book for Ages 2–4 | JoJo’s Blocks
products.metaDescription: A 28-page printable ABC coloring book for ages 2-4. Learn, color and trace the alphabet from A to Z, one letter and picture word at a time.

products.title: My First Animal Explorer
products.coverAlt: My First Animal Explorer cover — a lion, elephant, giraffe, monkey, rabbit and panda
products.description: Hello, little explorer! Meet lions, elephants, giraffes, pandas, monkeys and more — learn each animal's name, trace the word, count, match and color. A certificate of achievement waits at the end for every super animal explorer.
features: Meet lions, elephants, giraffes, pandas and more
Trace animal names, count, match and find shadows
Certificate of Achievement at the end
products.seoTitle: My First Animal Explorer | Printable Animal Coloring Book for Ages 3–6 | JoJo’s Blocks
products.metaDescription: A 30-page printable animal coloring and activity book. Meet the animals, trace their names, count, match and color - with a certificate at the end.

products.title: My Little Community Helpers
products.coverAlt: My Little Community Helpers cover — a firefighter, mail carrier, teacher, nurse, police officer and builder
products.description: Meet the people who help us every day! 24 community helpers — doctors, nurses, firefighters, police officers, teachers, veterinarians, electricians, mail carriers and more — with simple job descriptions, big coloring illustrations and a fun matching activity.
products.theme: Community helpers • The people who help us every day
features: 24 community helpers to meet and color
Simple job descriptions children can understand
Matching activity and a thank-you page
products.seoTitle: My Little Community Helpers | Printable Community Helpers Coloring Book for Ages 4–7 | JoJo’s Blocks
products.metaDescription: A 54-page printable coloring book with 24 community helpers. Learn what doctors, firefighters, teachers and more do, and color big illustrations.

products.title: My Little Space Adventure
products.coverAlt: My Little Space Adventure cover — a young astronaut, a friendly green alien and Rocket-7 under a smiling moon
products.description: Join Nova, Zippy the alien and Rocket-7 on a mission to find the missing Cosmic Crystal. Color planets and alien worlds, solve mazes and puzzles, decode alien messages and take the Space Explorer Quiz — with a Junior Space Explorer certificate at the end.
features: A story mission with Nova, Zippy and Rocket-7
Mazes, puzzles, counting, matching and alien-language codes
Creative coloring pages and a certificate
products.seoTitle: My Little Space Adventure | Printable Space Coloring Book for Ages 3–5 | JoJo’s Blocks
products.metaDescription: A 42-page printable space coloring and activity book for ages 3-5. Color planets, solve puzzles and join the mission to find the Cosmic Crystal.

products.title: JoJo's Blocks Complete Coloring Book Bundle
products.coverAlt: Complete 4-book bundle cover — collage of the four JoJo's Blocks book covers
products.description: Four favorite adventures in one bundle — 154 pages of coloring, tracing, puzzles and learning for one low price. Includes My First ABC Book (28 pages, ages 2–4), My First Animal Explorer (30 pages), My Little Community Helpers (54 pages, 24 helpers) and My Little Space Adventure (42 pages, ages 3–5). Download the PDFs, print at home, and color!
products.theme: All 4 books • Alphabet, animals, helpers & space
features: My First ABC Book — 28 pages, ages 2–4
My Little Community Helpers — 54 pages, 24 helpers
My Little Space Adventure — 42 pages, ages 3–5
products.seoTitle: Complete Coloring Book Bundle | Printable Coloring Books for Kids Ages 2–7 | JoJo’s Blocks
products.metaDescription: All four printable coloring books in one bundle: 154 pages of coloring, tracing, puzzles and learning activities for kids, in one PDF download.
